original_text: <!-- (Audio) Tom: Hey Alice, yeah, I feel a bit demotivated. One thing that really gets to me is working long hours without any breaks. It's exhausting, and it feels like I'm constantly running without knowing where I'm going. -->
translated_text: <!-- (Audio) Tom: Hej Alice, da, osećam se malo demotivovano. Ono što mi zaista smeta je raditi duge sate bez pauza. To je iscrpljujuće, i čini mi se da konstantno trčim bez da znam gde idem. -->
